author: feketesastar
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: feketesastar
quote: So far, I've played for 25 hours, and it's one of the best games I've ever played. The story, map, and graphics are all 10/10. You can compete and fish. Everything is very detailed. I especially love the lighting. The underwater world is also great, with a lot of animals, and the 30 fps is hardly noticeable. I can recommend this game to everyone.
